tha-ap320:1.1: Tiraṃsiya.] Kesarim abhijātaṃ va aggikkhandhaṃ va pabbate / obhāsentaṃ disā sabbā Siddhatthaṃ pabbatantare. // //
tha-ap320:2.1: Suriyassa ca ālokaṃ candālokaṃ tath' eva ca / Buddhālokañ ca disvāna vitti me upapajjatha. // //
tha-ap320:3.1: Tayo āloke disvāna disvāna sāvakuttamaṃ / ekaṃsaṃ ajinaṃ katvā santhaviṃ lokanāyakaṃ. // //
tha-ap320:4.1: Tayo hi ālokakarā loke lokatamonudā / cando ca suriyo cāpi Buddho ca lokanāyako. // //
tha-ap320:5.1: Opamam upadaṃsetvā kittito me mahāmuni / Buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ kittetvā kappaṃ saggamhi mod' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap320:6.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ Buddham abhikittayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi kittanāya idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap320:7.1: Ekasaṭṭhimhi 'to kappe eko Ñāṇadharo ahu / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap320:9.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Tiraṃsiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
